newsitem.title: UK: NatWest asks holders about concerns-paper.
newsitem.headline: NatWest asks holders about concerns-paper.

text.p: National Westminster Bank chairman Lord Alexander has written to the bank's biggest shareholders asking them if they have serious concerns about the management of the bank, the Guardian said on Monday.
The paper said the decision to write to fund managers and insurers comes on the back of publicly expressed dissatisfaction with the bank's strategy and leadership.
Some shareholders have agreed to meet Alexander in coming weeks.
The Guardian also said the chairman wrote to the Takeover Panel asking it to take action over the merger and takeover rumours surrounding NatWest. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
